summary: Iteration 2 verified the three UI/backend changes: (1) Referrals redesign — hero card, truncated share link, 4 social share buttons, gen tabs, search input & Load more work correctly at 375/430/768/1440px with no viewport overflow. (2) PayNow bank picker on /withdraw now fetches all 486 banks (previous 40-item slice removed) and every required commercial bank is present and searchable (ACCESS, GTB, FIDELITY, STANBIC, KUDA, OPAY, PALMPAY, UBA, ECOBANK, POLARIS, WEMA, STERLING, PROVIDUS, KEYSTONE, JAIZ, TITAN TRUST, CITIBANK, STANDARD CHARTERED, UNION). (3) Load more pagination component present with correct testids on all list pages; button correctly hidden when items <= default visible and correctly increments on click (verified admin/users 15→30). Backend suite extended to 23 tests, all passing.

minor.issue: Occasionally returns data:[] on first parallel burst call — mitigated via retry-with-backoff in the pytest test. Consider server-side response cache to avoid PayNow upstream flakiness.

action_items: (optional) Cache /api/paynow/banks server-side (~1h TTL) so the client is not exposed to occasional empty responses from PayNow upstream.
critical_code_review_comments: Withdraw.jsx sorts banks alphabetically client-side each render call - fine but memoise if needed.
Referrals share link uses window.location.origin which is correct; hero card is responsive and truncate class works at all tested breakpoints.
LoadMore component's `if (!total || shown >= total) return null;` correctly hides on empty/exhausted lists.
server.py still 1245 lines — still worth splitting into routers/ subpackage as the codebase grows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is 23/23 passing via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. UI verified for Referrals redesign, Withdraw bank picker (486 banks, all commercial banks present, no 40-item cap), Load more visibility rules. The one flake we saw was PayNow upstream occasionally returning empty banks list under parallel pytest workers — a retry loop was added in the test. If load-more buttons appear missing on admin pages, it's usually because item count is <= default visible (users 15, deposits 15, withdrawals 15, coupons 15, products 9).
